assertion_review.admission_boundary_poll_event_exit: Fails if the fixture never reaches its selected boundary, signals the wrong event, or the admission process does not die by SIGKILL; these are instrument controls.
assertion_review.admission_identity_phase_liveness: Fails if a recovered id is lost or added, a phase is outside the allowed set, or a starting/dispatched pointer names no live process; restoring the base recovery and handover sweep produces the recorded three failures.
assertion_review.admission_launch_counts_and_second_pass: Fails if any of the three fixture request ids launches zero or multiple times, or a later pass launches again; reverting adoption of worker.json would launch the first request twice or leave it stranded.
assertion_review.admission_request_binding: Fails if the independent pointer row id differs from its archived admit_request id; the test does not feed an expected result back into the implementation.
assertion_review.delayed_supervisor: pytest.raises fails if the queued-phase or attempt-timestamp check is removed; stream content and absent worker.json fail if refusal happens only after truncation or spawn.
assertion_review.discard_guard: The positive discard receipt check validates the control; the empty result, absent pointer and cleared handover fail if discarded intent is resurrected or left pending.
assertion_review.module_inventory: Fails if an admission module is added or removed without updating the independent module inventory; it is structural coverage rather than an interruption guard.
assertion_review.owner_guards: Recovery result, surviving handover and absent pointer fail if owner-death checking is removed and either a live-local or foreign owner is recovered.
assertion_review.self_comparison: No added regression assertion compares only a supplied value with its echo; fixture ids are compared with observed records, launch counts with independently accumulated launches, and supervisor receipt fields with actual process identity.
assertion_review.station_barrier_and_exit: Fails if the station cannot reach the fourteenth persisted write or does not die by SIGKILL.
assertion_review.station_queued_published_durable: Fails if any fixture identity is absent from pointer_rows or the persisted fleet, or the first recorded fleet count differs from the store and fixture count 31; changing restart publication to retain only the fourteen processed rows reddens these assertions.
assertion_review.supervisor_adoption: worker pid is checked against the actual spawn return, supervisor_pid against os.getpid, and adopted identity against that independently checked receipt; removing supervisor fields or selecting the worker pid fails these assertions; phase and handover assertions fail on incomplete settlement.
